Jamel Valencia

Fri, October 2, 2026 at 2:40 PM UTC

EL PASO, Texas (KTSM) - El Paso musician and paranormal investigator Alan Martinez is inviting the community to share their unexplained experiences at a special event next week.

Martinez will host "The Seance Room" on Oct. 7 at Bye, Bye Dear, located at 111 E. Robinson Avenue. The event will feature an open-mic format, giving attendees an opportunity to take the stage and share their own paranormal encounters.

Martinez joined Tricia and Mike on KTSM's "Second Cup," where he talked about his work investigating the paranormal and what attendees can expect from the upcoming event.

He also discussed his band, "As the City Sleeps," which is scheduled to perform during a Dia de los Muertos celebration in Downtown El Paso on Oct. 24.
